mapper.select: SELECT pur.patient_id FROM patient_user_relation pur INNER JOIN patient p ON p.id = pur.patient_id AND p.deleted_at IS NULL WHERE pur.user_id = #{userId} AND pur.relationship = 'SELF' AND pur.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY pur.created_at ASC, pur.id ASC LIMIT 1
SELECT user_id FROM patient_user_relation WHERE patient_id = #{patientId} AND deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY user_id ASC
SELECT id FROM c_user WHERE id = #{userId} AND deleted_at IS NULL FOR UPDATE
SELECT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM doctor WHERE id = #{doctorId} AND status = 'ENABLED' AND deleted_at IS NULL )
SELECT allergen, reaction FROM patient_allergy WHERE patient_id = #{patientId} AND deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY created_at ASC, id ASC
SELECT content, occurred_at FROM patient_medical_history WHERE patient_id = #{patientId} AND deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY created_at ASC, id ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO consult_record ( doctor_id, patient_id, status, chief_complaint, history_of_present_illness, attachments, ai_summary, pre_consultation_submitted_at, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{record.doctorId}, #{record.patientId}, #{record.status}, #{record.chiefComplaint}, #{record.historyOfPresentIllness}, CAST(#{record.attachmentsJson, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS jsonb), CAST(#{record.aiSummaryJson, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS jsonb), #{record.preConsultationSubmittedAt}, #{record.createdAt}, #{record.updatedAt} )
mapper.select: SELECT cr.id, cr.appointment_id, cr.patient_id, cr.status, d.id AS doctor_id, d.name AS doctor_name, d.title AS doctor_title, cr.chief_complaint, cr.history_of_present_illness, cr.attachments::text AS attachments_json, cr.updated_at AS saved_at, cr.pre_consultation_submitted_at AS submitted_at FROM consult_record cr LEFT JOIN doctor d ON d.id = cr.doctor_id WHERE cr.id = #{consultationId} AND cr.deleted_at IS NULL

SELECT cr.id, cr.appointment_id, cr.patient_id, cr.status, d.id AS doctor_id, d.name AS doctor_name, d.title AS doctor_title, cr.chief_complaint, cr.history_of_present_illness, cr.attachments::text AS attachments_json, cr.updated_at AS saved_at, cr.pre_consultation_submitted_at AS submitted_at FROM consult_record cr LEFT JOIN doctor d ON d.id = cr.doctor_id WHERE cr.id = #{consultationId} AND cr.deleted_at IS NULL FOR UPDATE OF cr
SELECT id, sender_type, content, created_at FROM consultation_message WHERE consult_id = #{consultationId} AND deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY created_at ASC, id ASC
SELECT id FROM prescription WHERE consult_id = #{consultationId} AND status = 'APPROVED' AND deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY issued_at ASC NULLS LAST, id ASC

SELECT p.id, p.consult_id AS consultation_id, d.name AS doctor_name, p.issued_at FROM prescription p LEFT JOIN doctor d ON d.id = p.doctor_id WHERE p.patient_id = #{patientId} AND p.status = 'APPROVED' AND p.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY p.issued_at DESC NULLS LAST, p.id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM prescription WHERE patient_id = #{patientId} AND status = 'APPROVED' AND deleted_at IS NULL
SELECT id, patient_id, status FROM prescription WHERE id = #{prescriptionId} AND deleted_at IS NULL

SELECT p.id, d.id AS doctor_id, d.name AS doctor_name, d.title AS doctor_title FROM prescription p LEFT JOIN doctor d ON d.id = p.doctor_id WHERE p.id = #{prescriptionId} AND p.status = 'APPROVED' AND p.deleted_at IS NULL

SELECT pi.drug_id, d.name AS drug_name, d.specification, pi.dosage, pi.frequency, pi.usage_method AS usage, pi.days AS duration_days FROM prescription_item pi INNER JOIN drug d ON d.id = pi.drug_id WHERE pi.prescription_id = #{prescriptionId} ORDER BY pi.id ASC
